vocab.title: Match each expression to its meaning
defs: the role you report to in the structure
to connect two sides so that they understand each other
the main office, where the global functions sit
a company that exists on its own inside a group
to take care of something and be responsible for it
the area and the limits of what a role covers
a person or a group with an interest in a decision
one part of a company with its own leader and its own results

items.situation: A new director asks: "What are you responsible for?"
tips: I am responsible for the people agenda of three entities.

items.situation: He asks: "Who do you report to?"
tips: I report to the Global HR Director at headquarters.

items.situation: He asks: "Which companies are inside your scope?"
tips: The bank, the finance company and the rental company.
Say the three entities slowly. He is new here.

items.situation: A colleague asks: "Who do you work with every day?"
tips: I work closely with the local managers and with finance.

items.situation: He asks: "What is not your responsibility?"
tips: Payroll operations are not in my scope. A shared services team takes care of that.
Saying what is outside your scope is part of the answer.

items.situation: He asks: "And what do you do between headquarters and the countries?"
tips: I act as a bridge between headquarters and the local managers.
act as a bridge BETWEEN two sides.

listenings.text: Hi Camila, it's Claire. I'm calling about Thursday. Mark Ridley starts on Monday as our new Global HR Director for Financial Services, and he wants to meet every HR Business Partner in the region this week. He has sixty minutes for the whole region, so each partner has one minute. One minute, no slides. Please tell him three things: which entities you look after, who you report to, and what is inside your scope this quarter. And send me two lines about that by Wednesday at noon, so I can put them in the agenda. One more thing. He is new to South America, so say the names of the three companies slowly. Thanks, Camila. We speak on Thursday.

Hello, everyone. This is Mark Ridley. I start on Monday as Global HR Director for Financial Services, and I am recording this because I cannot meet all of you in person this week. A short introduction. I am based at headquarters, in Paris. For the last four years I looked after the rental business in Europe, so the bank and the finance company are new for me. My scope now is twelve countries and three entities, and I work closely with the CFO and with the country managers. In my first month I want to understand how each entity really works. So on Thursday, tell me three things: what you are responsible for, who your stakeholders are, and one problem you deal with every week. One minute each is enough. Thank you, and see you on Thursday.
